title:
TAKING A STRANGER
ON A HOT AIR BALLOON 🇮🇱
beats: HOOK: Hey, excuse me, sorry. Are you from Israel? - Hi, no, I am from Berlin
THE SETUP he said was missing: Is it your first time? - No, I have been here before but it has been 10 years ago - It has been 10 years!
THE OFFER: to celebrate you coming back to Israel after 10 years I am going to rent a hot air balloon - What? - and I am going to take you on it + her reaction
SHE SAYS YES: Okay, if not now, when then? Okay, lets do it - Okay, lets go
GETTING IN THE TAXI (Tal on V3): All right, come on. We are going on a hot air balloon. Let me get the door for you - Thank you
Tal getting in: All right, here we go, guys. Lets go
TAXI: are you ready? - I am scared - Lets go
arriving: pointing at the balloon - we are going to go on that thing - Yeah, I know
the high five with the guy
ON THE BALLOON, WE LAUGH: Are you scared? - What, me? No - Tal laughing with her
You ever thought you would be doing this today? - I would never. I would never.
the view (b-roll) under her Look at the view
THE GUY: I am the only person in Israel playing guitar on the balloon
MUSIC STARTS (bed = his real playing, in sync here): the songs for you, Patricia - whip to her
b-roll: both in the gondola, balloon above, sunset
HER SPEAKING (music ducks): I was so scared and it is so wonderful
I am happy I said yes
THE LIGHT: her at night, the lamps on
the lit balloon above them, waving
GET OFF: Tal - Wow, that was so cool. How was it?
her whole answer, not cut off: Amazing. It was so much fun. And so happy I left my comfort zone
NEXT SURPRISE: a restaurant that has a drag show - Oh, okay - Are you down to go with me? - Of course
THE TAXI DRIVER, on the way to the drag show: Excuse me, brother. Whats your name? - Fadi - Nice to meet you. Where are you from? - From Taybeh - Mashallah
Are you Muslim? - Yeah - Nice to meet you, bro. Salam alaykum
MEETING THE DRAG QUEEN, sitting down: Hi. How are you? My name is Tal - This is my friend Patricia - Patricia! We had a drag queen named Patricia
She has not been in Israel for 10 years - Really? - So I took her to visit - Thank you for coming to my humble abode
What do you want the world to know about Israel? - it is very welcoming and amazing. And you can come see me here
LAST SHOT: cheers for welcome back to Israel after 10 years. Lets go
ENDING (Tal on V3): her - Thank you though, you really took me out of my comfort zone and gave me a great day - Tal: you got to see the side of Israel that most people dont see
GOODBYE: You are actually so amazing. Welcome to Israel, this is your home - Thank you very much - After 10 years - Yes. Good celebration
